description: Average REALIZED SALE price (not list price) per storage/variant for a device, updated daily, plus a sample of individual recent sold listings with date, condition, carrier, storage and price. This is the "what did it actually sell for" answer, distinct from device_prices (active listing averages). Accepts free-text device name or exact slug.

carrier.description: Optional carrier filter, e.g. "unlocked", "att", "verizon", "t-mobile". Varies by device.

condition.description: Optional filter: new, mint, good, or fair.

storage.description: Optional storage filter, e.g. "128gb". Varies by device.

name: sale_prices
title: Sale Prices
